readerCopy.body: A relationship can be loving and still depend on one person wanting less than they actually do. When Venus squares Lilith, connection and autonomy create friction around desire, boundaries, attraction, money, pleasure, or an agreement that no longer fits as neatly as everyone would prefer. The want does not automatically make the relationship wrong and affection cannot solve a conflict nobody is allowed to name. The terms become more honest when both people can exist inside them without one person's desire having to disappear.
